001: Shota, what do you do on your days off?
These days, I mostly just go running.
Running, huh? Do you run every day?
No, about three times a week. It helps me clear my head.
That sounds nice. Maybe I should start too.
Want to run together? It's fun.
002: I love cooking, and I'm always trying out new recipes.
That's impressive. What kind of food do you make?
Lately, mostly Japanese food. I make the broth from scratch.
That's pretty serious. Could you teach me sometime?
Of course. Let's definitely cook together.
003: Takuya, do you like watching movies?
Yes, I love them. I especially like sci-fi movies.
I like sci-fi too. Do you have any recommendations?
A movie I saw recently was really good.
Now I'm curious. Tell me the title.
Let's talk about it while we watch it together sometime.
004: Kenta, do you play any instruments?
I started playing guitar in college. I'm still not very good though.
What kind of songs are you practicing?
I'm practicing songs by my favorite artist.
005: I heard you like taking pictures, Sakura.
Yes, I go out with my camera on my days off.
What do you usually take pictures of?
Mostly nature scenes. I especially love sunsets.
That's lovely. Please show me your photos.
Sure. I'll bring my album next time.
006: Yuki, what do you do on the weekends?
I often read books at the park.
That sounds like a nice, relaxing time.
It is. It's quiet and very calming.
What genre of books do you read?
Lately, I've been really into mystery novels.
007: Daisuke, do you play any sports?
Yes, I play basketball with my coworkers.
We rent a gym nearby and play on the weekends.
Sounds fun. Can I come watch?
Of course. Please come cheer us on.
008: I heard you like growing plants, Ai.
Yes, I grow succulents in my room.
They don't need much watering, so they're easy even for beginners.
Maybe I should try it too.
I recommend it. I'll teach you how to take care of them.
009: Yes, I love it. I travel around the country a lot.
Kyoto was the best. I could really feel the history there.
I'd like to go to Kyoto too.
The fall foliage season is the best time to go.
010: Misaki, is there anything you collect?
I buy magnets whenever I travel abroad.
That must be a nice souvenir.
It is. I have ones from twenty countries now.
That's amazing. Where do you buy them?
I make a point to buy them at the airport in each country.
